de: Besuchen Sie Blake's Cottage, das ehemalige Wohnhaus des Dichters William Blake mit seinem markanten Reetdach.
Sprechen Sie den Namen wie ein Einheimischer aus: 'Felf-fm'.
Prüfen Sie die Gezeiten (Tide Times) vor Ihrem Besuch, um die besten Sandabschnitte zum Muschelsammeln zu finden.
Achten Sie im Sommer auf die saisonalen Hundeverbote am Hauptstrand, der Bereich Richtung Middleton ist meist zugänglicher.
Folgen Sie dem Blue Plaque Trail, um die Häuser berühmter ehemaliger Bewohner zu entdecken.
hu: Nézd meg Blake kunyhóját (Blake's Cottage), ahol a híres költő, William Blake élt és alkotott.
Ejtse a város nevét úgy, mint a helyiek: 'Felf-fm'.
Ellenőrizd az apály-dagály táblázatot, mert apálykor bukkannak elő a legjobb homokos részek.
Nyáron figyelj a kutyás korlátozásokra a főstrandon; Middleton felé szabadabb a part.
Járd végig a Blue Plaque útvonalat, amely a falu híres lakóinak házait mutatja be.
ro: Vizitează Blake's Cottage, fosta casă a poetului William Blake, o clădire istorică cu acoperiș de stuf.
Pronunță numele localității ca un localnic: 'Felf-fm'.
Verifică orele mareei înainte de a merge la plajă pentru a găsi cele mai bune locuri cu nisip.
Atenție la restricțiile pentru câini pe plaja principală între mai și septembrie; zona spre Middleton este mai permisivă.
Urmează traseul plăcuțelor albastre (Blue Plaque Trail) pentru a descoperi istoria celebrităților locale.
en: Visit Blake's Cottage, the historic thatched home where poet William Blake lived and wrote.
Pronounce the village name as 'Felf-fm' to sound like a true West Sussex local.
Check the tide times before heading to the beach to find the best sandy patches and rock pools.
Be aware of seasonal dog restrictions on the main beach from May to September; walk east for more access.
Follow the Blue Plaque Trail to see the former homes of famous residents like Dante Gabriel Rossetti.

en.name: Lobster Pot Café

ro.name: Hotham Park

en.name: Walk to Middleton-on-Sea
en.tip: Walk east along the beach for a much quieter, more remote experience away from the main promenade.

en.name: Hotham Park
en.tip: Located on the edge of the village, this park offers 22 acres of quiet walled gardens and a boating lake.
